recommendations.section: ## 3. The Economics Front Applied to AI Agents: Who Has Intervened
recommendations.current: Enumerating the measurement wave keeps the intervention count honest. Budget-set GARP testing across risk, time, social and food domains returns efficiency scores above human benchmarks — CCEI averages above 0.997 — robust to sampling randomness and demographic framing but sensitive to the linguistic framing of the choice situation [30][7]. A taxonomy of fine-grained rationality elements scored across fourteen models finds that size affects the ability to behave rationally [31]. Nearly forty models put through 161 rounds of priced moral dilemmas against a null distribution of random choosers yield two passes at the 1% level, five more at 5% and two more at 10%, with pairwise co-classification into the same rationalizable type running 24% to 48% [32]. Prompt-based role specialisation *increases* axiom violations and lowers the efficiency index [33]. Holding a model fixed and re-running a 25-round budget task 100 times yields a full CCEI distribution rather than a point [34]. A central-bank working paper testing whether a reservation-wage policy exists in a sequential search environment finds larger models rationalizable nearly always, the smallest (Mistral v0.3 7B) not rationalizable at all, and reasoning-tuned variants *worse* than their base, with recovered discount factors clustering between 0.2 and 0.8 [18]. A discrete-choice model recovers the cost function best rationalizing a model's choices across four clinical diagnosis domains, and finds revealed-preference estimates explain realised decisions far better than verbalised cost ratios [35]; a companion test finds elicited beliefs are not decision-sufficient, with conditional mutual information significantly positive in all sixteen cells [9].

recommendations.section: ## 1. What Counts as an Intervention, and What Counts as Mere Measurement
recommendations.current: **Abstention is not repair.** Running the same agent repeatedly and answering only when three runs agree lifts accuracy to 87–88% at 54–62% coverage, a 6-to-14-point gain over single-run baselines — but the agent's choices are not thereby made more consistent; the inconsistent cases are removed from the sample [17]. **Level-steering is not projection.** Activation steering along a control vector — a difference direction computed from contrasting-pair prompts and added to the residual stream — reliably shifts allocations toward payoff maximisation [18], and a steering vector built by aligning a behaviourally elicited risk-preference map to residual-stream activations shifts risky-choice probabilities [19]; both move the *location* of a preference, not the *coherence* of a choice sequence. **Architectural augmentation is not enforcement.** Surveys catalogue tools, symbolic reasoners, explicit utility functions and conformal risk controls as routes to "more rational" agents [20]; these change an agent's inputs or computation, not the algebraic structure of its choices.

recommendations.section: ## 2. The Economics Front: Afriat, Varian, Houtman-Maks and What They Offer as Repair
recommendations.current: Five indices now measure how badly a dataset fails. CCEI deflates budgets by a common factor and reports the largest factor at which cycles vanish; it is computable in polynomial time by binary search with a combinatorial GARP check at each step [7]. The Varian index refines this to observation-specific deflations. The Houtman–Maks index deletes whole observations. The Dean–Martin minimum cost index deletes revealed-preference *relations*, weighted by money-metric cost. The money-pump index measures the dollars an arbitrageur could extract by trading against the agent's own revealed choices, as a share of expenditure [22].
recommendations.recommended:

- **CCEI** deflates budgets by a common factor and reports the largest factor at which cycles vanish; it is computable in polynomial time by binary search with a combinatorial GARP check at each step [7].

- **The Houtman–Maks index** deletes whole observations.

recommendations.section: ## 3. The Economics Front Applied to AI Agents: Who Has Intervened
recommendations.current: **Weight-level axiom enforcement.** Llama 3.1 8B Instruct is fine-tuned toward two principal-specified risk-aversion targets with a multi-term loss whose auxiliary terms are, term by term, revealed-preference axioms: a reflexivity term penalising a non-zero logit gap on placebo menus where both labels describe the same portfolio; a mirror term penalising asymmetry under label-swapping; two independence-of-irrelevant-alternatives terms tying the average and dispersion of the three-option logit gap to the two-option gap for the same pair, so that adding a strictly dominated third alternative cannot shift the odds between the original two; a cycle term penalising the additivity residual across binary triads with a sign-margin hinge — transitivity written as a loss; and a path term forcing interpolation paths to bracket the indifference surface [6]. The effects are large and, crucially, *not monotone*.
recommendations.rationale: A single 848-character sentence carries the five loss terms that are the report's clearest example of axioms written as trainable penalties; bulleting them exposes the one-term-per-axiom mapping and simultaneously breaks an 1,800-character paragraph at its results hinge.

recommendations.section: ## 3. The Economics Front Applied to AI Agents: Who Has Intervened
recommendations.current: **Label-free regularization, specified and unrun.** Three penalties, each continuous, each polynomial-time computable, each zero if and only if the corresponding representation theorem's axiom holds: the Dutch-book magnitude, obtained as the optimal value of a linear program bounded by total stake; one minus CCEI, via binary search with a GARP check at each step; and one minus the subjective-expected-utility distance, computable by binary search over the finitely many payoff ratios [7]. A supporting lemma addresses the known CCEI loophole, but only inside its hypothesis: with prices drawn independently from Lebesgue densities and budget-exhausting choices, CCEI equals 1 if and only if GARP holds, with probability one [7]. That is a guarantee about a *sampler*, not a property of the estimator,
recommendations.rationale: Three genuinely parallel penalties are buried in one 487-character colon sentence, and pulling them out also splits a 1,530-character paragraph at the point where description turns into critique.

Descendants extend the idea rather than the enforcement: a proximal-point outer loop removes a stability restriction on the regularization coefficient and yields last-iterate guarantees without it [44]; a multiplayer generalisation replaces the single opponent with a population [45]; an exploratory variant achieves O(√T) regret without exponential dependence on the KL-regularization parameter, improvable to O(log T) with a minimax oracle [46]; and a social-choice framing shows the Nash family approximates **maximal lotteries** — the randomised social-choice rule that is majority-undominated — inheriting majority support and robustness to irrelevant alternatives [47], with a leaderboard-aggregation application that assumes nothing about preference structure [48].

recommendations.section: ## 5. The ML/Alignment Front Applied to Agent Choice: Enforce or Accept?
recommendations.current: Both camps have shipped working systems on real agents. The enforcement camp is larger and better evidenced on non-preference metrics; the acceptance camp has the stronger theory and the weaker identification. This front has a measurement-only wave too, the same contrast class §3A draws on the economics side: per-instance transitivity diagnostics with conformal prediction sets [56]; behavioural consistency used as an uncertainty signal, with abstention rather than repair as the response [17]; elicited utility structure that is coherent and motivationally inert [58]; the measurement half of the non-transitivity judge audit [51]; and the dominant reward benchmark, which scores accuracy on prompt–chosen–rejected trios with no consistency construct at all [40]. None of these changes anything either.
recommendations.rationale: Five measurement-only works are listed with idle semicolons, and bulleting them mirrors the treatment rec-1 gives the economics-side contrast class in §3A, making the two exclusion waves visibly parallel.
